subject: Order Form / MSA: clarify net terms, VAT evidence and payment cadence

Subject: Pelion Order Form (first pass redline) — net terms / VAT questions

Hi Ana / Marco — attaching our proposed order form redline (PDF) and a simple payment schedule spreadsheet. A few quick asks so we can get this routed to finance/legal on your side:

- Can you confirm the billing entity for the PO and whether Pelion will self-bill or expects Redwood to invoice the EU entity?
- Procurement asked whether Pelion can request Net45; our standard is Net30 for first-year pilots but we can accommodate Net45 for enterprise deals — need confirmation if Net45 is a hard requirement.
- For VAT: could you share any local VAT certificate or a sample tax residency doc we should include? I also attached a blank VAT_Cert_Template for your team to fill if helpful.

We're looping legal and deals ops (Kimberly & Karthik) to accelerate redline review once you confirm the billing entity and payment cadence. If we can lock PO entity + net terms this week, we can get countersigned next week.

Attachments: Pelion_OrderForm_v1_redline.pdf, PaymentSchedule.xlsx, VAT_Cert_Template.docx

Thanks —
Ben

Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 11:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Pelion Order Form (first pass redline) — net terms / VAT questions

Hi Ben — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. Quick responses from procurement/legal here: 

- Billing entity: Pelion Health Ltd (UK) — PO will be issued to that entity. We generally self-bill for SaaS where vendors are non-UK, but for this engagement procurement prefers Redwood to invoice Pelion Health Ltd. Can you confirm the invoice recipient details and company name you will print on the invoice?
- Net terms: Procurement prefers Net60 for larger annual contracts; Net45 is acceptable but we need to confirm internally. Is Net45 something Redwood can commit to in the order form or do you require a Net30 clause in the MSA?
- VAT: We require a copy of Redwood's VAT registration and a standard template showing how VAT will be charged. If Redwood is not VAT-registered in the UK, procurement will need to know whether reverse charge applies.

Also, can you add a short clause about invoicing cadence and remittance instructions in the order form (we typically need a field stating: "Invoices issued monthly in arrears / net X days").

We will push PO generation once the invoice recipient and net terms are agreed. Happy to schedule a 20-min call if useful.

Regards,
Ana Costa

Ana — thanks, that helps. Short answers and proposed next steps: 

- Invoice recipient: we will invoice to "Redwood Inference Inc." by default; for Pelion Health Ltd (UK) please confirm if you prefer the invoice to list Pelion Health Ltd as the recipient and Redwood to issue invoices to the UK address. We can print: Pelion Health Ltd, 44 Queen St, London, UK, VAT ID: [you to provide].
- Net terms: Redwood can accept Net45 for this deal provided the PO is issued to the correct billing entity before the first invoice. We ask that Net45 be added to the order form under Payment Terms. If Pelion requires Net60 we need a level-of-approval (sales leadership) — I can escalate if necessary.
- VAT / reverse charge: if Pelion Health Ltd is VAT-registered and provides the VAT number we will not charge VAT on exported services and will include a note about reverse charge on the invoice. If Redwood needs to charge VAT (e.g., invoicing a UK-registered vendor scenario) we will show VAT line items and provide VAT registration evidence. 

Kimberly / Karthik: posting here to ask legal whether we should propose the following minimal language for the order form to avoid re-opening the MSA:

"Billing and Taxes: Redwood will invoice the billing entity listed on the Order Form. Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Pelion Health Ltd shall be responsible for all taxes, duties and similar governmental assessments (except for Redwood's income taxes). If Pelion provides a valid VAT registration number and indicates that reverse charge applies, Redwood will invoice net of UK VAT and reference the reverse charge on the invoice."

Can legal confirm if the above is OK or suggest tightened wording? Also please attach a version of the redline that explicitly adds the Payment Terms line (Net45) to the order form.

Thanks — I can get a confirm from procurement on PO issuance once legal signs off.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Dec 2025 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Pelion Order Form (first pass redline) — net terms / VAT questions

Ben / Kim — quick legal run-through and language suggestion. Overall reasonable ask; recommend we accept Net45 on the order form with two conditions and add one small clause around tax gross-up. Proposed edits below (we'll attach a redline PDF for signature):

1) Payment terms: Add to Order Form: "Payment Terms: Pelion Health Ltd shall pay all undisputed invoices within forty-five (45) days of receipt. Invoices shall be issued monthly in arrears unless otherwise set forth in the Payment Schedule attached to this Order Form."

2) PO / invoice recipient: Add a required field on page 1 of the Order Form: "Billing entity (as to be shown on invoice) — required". Sales should confirm the exact legal name and address before sending to procurement.

3) VAT / Taxes: Add a short clause to avoid future disputes: "Taxes: Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Customer is responsible for any VAT, sales or other transaction taxes arising from the purchase of Services. If Customer provides a valid VAT registration number and indicates that reverse charge applies, Vendor will issue invoices net of VAT and reference the reverse charge mechanism. If tax authorities later determine Vendor owes VAT due to invoicing to a different entity, Customer agrees to cooperate and (to the extent permitted by law) reimburse Vendor for any VAT and related penalties/interest resulting from incorrect billing information provided by Customer."

4) Approval path: we can accept Net45 without sales leadership approval if total contract value < $350k ARR; otherwise Ben please escalate for final sign-off.

Action items for Ben: please confirm billing entity (Pelion Health Ltd) and whether procurement can accept Net45. If yes, send the attached redline (Pelion_OrderForm_v1_redline_FINAL.pdf) to procurement with attachments and request PO generation. I'll include our VAT certificate and payment schedule template in the reply.

Attachment: Pelion_OrderForm_v1_redline_FINAL.pdf (legal suggested), Redwood_VAT_Cert.pdf

Thanks — Karthik
